choices.A: It will rain for 70% of the time tomorrow.
choices.B: It will rain in 70% of the area tomorrow.
choices.C: Rain is relatively likely tomorrow, but it is not certain.

question: A weather forecast says, “The probability of precipitation tomorrow is 70%.” Which of the following interpretations is correct?
solution: A 70% probability of precipitation means that rain is relatively likely, but it is a random event and is not guaranteed to occur. It also does not represent a proportion of time or area.
